newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Pacific Concord up on spinoff rumours.
newsitem.headline: Pacific Concord up on spinoff rumours.

text.p: Shares of property investment, telecommunications and department store group Pacific Concord Holding Ltd rose to a 52-week high of HK$1.95 on Thursday morning on rumours it was planning a spinoff, brokers said.

"There is talk that the company is planning to spin off either its telecommunications or property business. Speculation about exceptional gains fuelled buying," said a dealing manager at a regional brokerage.
Company officials were not immediately available for comment. Pacific Concord shares rose ended the morning HK$0.06 higher at HK$1.94 on volume of 22.42 million shares.
